## func TestPlanRequest

```go
func TestPlanRequest(targets ...model.AgentID) setup.PlanRequest
```

TestPlanRequest builds a setup.PlanRequest populated with all catalog entries for the given targets. It is shared between takt/setup and cmd/takt\-ai test suites to avoid duplicating the same builder in two packages.
